info.name: SportCenter Phase 1.5 Consultation Request Management
info.description: TC01-TC48 are HTTP checks. TC49-TC53 are SQL Server-only checks described in the coverage matrix. Run only against an isolated disposable test database with dedicated accounts, never SportCenterDB.
